title: AuditFinding
description: Specification for an individual defect, architectural concern, or finding identified during package audit.

id.description: Unique finding ID assigned by the agent (e.g., ARCH-001, DB-003, SEC-002, COMP-001).

root_cause_id.description: Root cause identifier for linking and deduplicating related findings across agents (e.g., RC-MIGRATION-PREFIX, RC-UNBOUND-RAW-SQL).

category.description: Audit category domain of the finding.

severity.description: Severity level: blocker (must not release), critical (very high risk/breaking), major (serious defect), minor (maintainability/DX), info (observation/recommendation).

title.description: Concise summary title of the finding.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the issue, context, impact, and consequences for consumers.

file.description: Relative file path within package repository (e.g., src/Services/PaymentGateway.php).

symbol.description: Name of class, method, interface, trait, or function, if applicable.

evidence.description: Deterministic proof: command output, error log, code citation, or reproducible test result.

recommendation.description: Concrete remediation guidance and code example.

confidence.description: Confidence level: 0.90-1.00 = directly verified, 0.75-0.89 = strong evidence, 0.50-0.74 = plausible/partially verified, <0.50 = weak hypothesis.

requires_human_decision.description: Whether this finding requires human architectural or product confirmation.

decision_context.description: Context, tradeoffs, and available options for the developer if requires_human_decision is true.

command.description: CLI command to verify the fix during remediation (e.g., vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/PrefixTest.php).

expected.description: Expected result or output substring proving successful remediation.
